sections.heading: What is ISMS?
sections.content: The Integrated Scheme Management System provides a unified digital platform for accessing government schemes, submitting Expressions of Interest, making applicable payments and tracking application status through a transparent online workflow.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.content: Promote transparency, reduce manual paperwork, ensure efficient processing of EOIs, and provide citizens and businesses with a reliable way to engage with government schemes.

sections.heading: Benefits
sections.content: Online application, digital receipt, real‑time status tracking, secure payment processing, and centralized scheme information.
